description: This current moment is my happily ever after, anything extra is an addition. #intentionalliving #freedom #selflove
transcript: Nothing comes my way that is not supposed to. Everything is intentional. My life is my happily ever after. Anything I add to my life is an addition. It is not a necessity. I am already living a full life. I don't go seeking validation. Acceptance is a battle that I will never win. Do not force anyone or anything to understand me.
